transition_definition: One 0.02 s action window in one environment. Vector steps multiply by num_envs.
normalization: Fixed local-rays-v1 scales; no learned running normalizer.
reward: 100*food_delta + energy_delta - 0.02*collision_count_delta - 0.001*(drive+3*escape). Food uses physical World consumption.
termination: Body energy <=0.05 terminates. The 250-step episode limit truncates, with final-observation value bootstrap and no GAE continuation across reset.
sequence_protocol: PPO on contiguous truncated-BPTT chunks; stored behavior hidden state initializes each chunk, episode_start resets state inside chunks. Gaussian latent likelihood is optimized before shared deterministic action transform.
scene_distribution: Equal forage, obstacle, threat/control, relocation cases; independent named train/dev/test/stress map streams. Food relocation is scheduled at reset.
hybrid_reflex: Same training/evaluation apply_action function; shared proximity and projection change only. Record raw action/log probability/applied action/reflex corrections separately.
purpose: Short integration and throughput probe; not a trained release model.
